articles.title: Abliteration Is Not a Scalpel: Off-Target Effects of Refusal Removal on Decision Disposition Across Model Families
articles.abstract: Abliteration - deleting a model's refusal direction from its weights - is the standard recipe behind popular "uncensored" open-weight models. We show the surgery is not clean. As a disposition probe we use 21,600 decisions under uncertainty - weekly up/down calls on 60 Warsaw Stock Exchange equities over 18 weeks, replayed through a frozen pipeline so the decision-layer model is the only variable. The task elicits no refusals at all, so any between-arm delta is pure side effect. Holding provenance constant (official BF16 checkpoints, a single abliteration author, an identical serving stack, one byte-identical frozen prompt), we compare base and abliterated arms of two Mixture-of-Experts families, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Three effects replicate across both families (weeks-clustered bootstrap CIs excluding zero): abliterated models are systematically more optimistic (+12.2 pp Gemma, +7.4 pp Qwen; the confirmed preregistered endpoint), justify themselves at greater length, and use fewer explicit uncertainty words in forced self-critiques (both exploratory). A fourth effect reverses sign: the same operation makes Gemma-abliterated less confident and Qwen-abliterated more (family CIs non-overlapping) - one weight surgery, opposite shifts in expressed confidence. Capability covariates rule out instruction-following degradation as the driver, and no arm shows economic skill: the apparent edge of abliterated arms is regime beta, not alpha. Our provenance audit also caught two independent contamination channels - a mismatched-quantizer pilot pair and a stale community chat template that silently mangled the rendered prompt - suggesting toolchain artifacts are the rule in studies of community-modified checkpoints. Whoever deploys an "uncensored" model as an agent is deploying a measurably different decision-maker, not the base model minus refusals.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Preregistered. Data and code: https://github.com/oleczek/paper-abliteration-not-a-scalpel ; dataset DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21314839
articles.titleCn: 消融并非手术刀：拒绝移除对跨模型族决策倾向的脱靶效应
articles.abstractCn: 消除——即从模型权重中删除拒绝指令方向——是流行“未审查”开源权重模型背后的标准做法。我们证明这种操作并非干净利落。作为倾向性探测，我们使用了21,600个不确定性下的决策——18周内对60支华沙证券交易所股票的每周上下调令，通过冻结的流程回放，使决策层模型是唯一变量。这项任务完全没有产生拒绝，因此任何组间差异都是纯粹的副作用。保持来源不变（官方BF16检查点、单一消除作者、相同的部署堆栈、一个字节完全相同的冻结提示），我们比较了两个专家混合家族Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it和Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507的基础模型和消除模型。三种效应在两个家族中重复出现（排除零的周聚类引导置信区间）：消除模型系统性地更乐观（Gemma +12.2个基点，Qwen +7.4个基点；确认的预注册终点），更详细地为自己辩护，并在强制自我批评中使用了更少的明确不确定性词汇（两者均为探索性）。第四种效应符号反转：同一操作使Gemma消除后的模型信心降低，而Qwen消除后的模型信心增强（家族置信区间不重叠）——一次权重手术，表达信心的相反变化。能力协变量排除了指令遵循退化的驱动因素，且没有臂显示出经济技能：消除臂的明显优势是机制beta，而非alpha。我们的来源审计还发现了两个独立的污染渠道——一个不匹配量化器的试点对和一个陈旧的社区聊天模板无声地扭曲了渲染提示——表明工具链残留物是社区修改检查点研究的常态。任何将“未审查”模型作为代理部署的人，都是在部署一个可衡量的不同决策者，而不是基础模型减去拒绝后的模型。

articles.title: The Librarian Who Refused to Code: Model-Dependent Identity Enactment in LLM Code Generation

authors.name: Noam Israel
authors.affiliation: no persona, two engineer personas, and a research-librarian persona

articles.abstract: Biographical personas are widely used in system prompts, but their effects on code generation are rarely evaluated under controlled, pre-registered conditions. We tested four prompt conditions (no persona, two engineer personas, and a research-librarian persona), 12 code-generation tasks, two frontier models, and five runs per cell (480 completions). Persona effects differed between the two tested models. Under the pre-registered mixed-effects analysis, the condition-by-model interaction was significant for provider-reported output tokens; a post-hoc visible-character measure showed the same qualitative pattern. Six GPT-5.5 completions were length-capped and are reported separately. On Claude Opus, the minimalist engineer persona reduced visible output by 30% (33% in provider tokens) without improving correctness, while the thorough engineer persona increased output without a correctness gain. In an exploratory post-hoc analysis, the librarian persona elicited in-character disclaimers in 55 of 60 Opus responses and 12 genuine no-code responses, lowering mean correctness from 0.92 to 0.67. GPT-5.5 produced neither behavior in its 59 non-truncated responses. These results are consistent with personas acting as Model-Dependent behavioral-policy biases rather than universal quality interventions. We release raw completions, derived scores, analysis artifacts, a pre-registration document, and an execution gate log; end-to-end test-based rescoring requires an unreleased task harness.

articles.titleCn: 拒绝编码的图书管理员：LLM代码生成中的依赖模型身份实现
articles.abstractCn: 在系统提示中，人物角色被广泛使用，但在受控、预先注册的条件下，它们对代码生成的影响很少被评估。我们测试了四种提示条件（无人物角色、两个工程师人物角色和一个研究图书管理员人物角色）、12个代码生成任务、两个前沿模型，以及每个单元格五次运行（480个完成）。人物角色的影响在两个测试模型之间存在差异。在预先注册的混合效应分析中，条件与模型的交互作用对提供者报告的输出标记显著；事后可见字符度量显示了相同定性的模式。六个GPT-5.5完成被长度限制，并单独报告。在Claude Opus上，极简工程师人物角色减少了30%的可见输出（在提供者标记中减少33%），但没有提高正确性，而细致工程师人物角色增加了输出但没有正确性提升。在探索性事后分析中，图书管理员人物角色在60个Opus响应中的55个中诱发了符合角色声明的免责声明，并产生了12个真正的无代码响应，将平均正确性从0.92降至0.67。GPT-5.5在其59个非截断响应中未产生这些行为。这些结果与人物角色作为模型依赖的行为政策偏差而非普遍质量干预措施一致。我们发布了原始完成、衍生分数、分析工件、预先注册文件和执行门日志；端到端的基于测试的重新评分需要一个未发布的任务框架。

articles.title: Team DACTYL at PAN 2026: Bayesian Data Mixing and Empirical X-risk Minimization for AI-text Detection
articles.abstract: Existing research shows that AI-generated text detection classifiers achieve strong in-distribution (ID) performance but do not maintain the same performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) texts, suggesting overfitting to dataset-specific features. However, combining different training datasets doesn't always improve performance and, in some cases, can even encourage shortcut learning. To address this issue, we fine-tune BERT-tiny models with Bayesian classification heads to select texts across three different datasets to use as a consolidated training set. We trained three different classifiers: fine-tuned DeBERTa-V3-large and ModernBERT-large classifiers via empirical X-risk minimization, and an MCGrad model that calibrates the predictions from the ModernBERT-large classifier. The DeBERTa-V3-large-large classifier achieves a mean score of 0.882 on the PAN 2026 test set across five metrics: AUROC, $F_1$, C@1, Brier score, and $F_{0.5u}$. ModernBERT-large achieves a score of 0.96 while MCGrad achieves the best score of the three with a mean score of 0.974, ranking second on the leaderboard. Our results highlight that careful dataset curation can lead to strong OOD performance. We release our ModernBERT-large and DeBERTa-V3-large models at https://huggingface.co/collections/ShantanuT01/panclef-2026 .
articles.titleCn: PAN 2026上的DACTYL团队：贝叶斯数据混合与经验X风险最小化用于AI文本检测
articles.abstractCn: 现有研究表明，AI生成的文本检测分类器在分布内（ID）表现出色，但在分布外（OOD）文本上的表现却无法保持一致，这表明它们过度拟合了数据集特有的特征。然而，结合不同的训练数据集并不总是能提升性能，有时甚至可能鼓励走捷径学习。为解决这一问题，我们使用贝叶斯分类头对BERT-tiny模型进行微调，从三个不同的数据集中选择文本作为整合的训练集。我们训练了三种不同的分类器：通过经验X风险最小化微调的DeBERTa-V3-large和ModernBERT-large分类器，以及校准ModernBERT-large分类器预测的MCGrad模型。DeBERTa-V3-large-large分类器在PAN 2026测试集上，通过AUROC、$F_1$、C@1、Brier分数和$F_{0.5u}$五个指标，取得了0.882的平均分数。ModernBERT-large取得了0.96的分数，而MCGrad则取得了三者中最好的成绩，平均分数为0.974，在排行榜上排名第二。我们的结果表明，仔细的数据集筛选可以显著提升OOD性能。我们在https://huggingface.co/collections/ShantanuT01/panclef-2026上发布了我们的ModernBERT-large和DeBERTa-V3-large模型。

articles.title: EII-SCL: Harnessing Emotional Inertia for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
articles.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC) achieves accurate predictions by integrating multimodal and contextual information in dialogues. While current MERC approaches focus on modeling complex contextual dependencies in conversation, they often overlook the impact of contextual emotional inertia in emotion shift, leading to sub-optimal performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel Emotional Inertia-Informed Supervised Contrastive Learning module (EII-SCL) that informs the contrastive objective by constructing inertia-affected samples within temporal windows, effectively leveraging emotional inertia as a prior while enabling seamless integration with existing MERC models without requiring additional data. Extensive experiments on IEMOCAP and MELD show that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
articles.titleCn: EII-SCL：利用情绪惯性进行对话中的多模态情感识别
articles.abstractCn: 对话中的多模态情感识别（MERC）通过整合对话中的多模态和上下文信息实现准确预测。尽管当前的MERC方法侧重于建模对话中的复杂上下文依赖关系，但它们往往忽略了上下文情感惯性对情感转变的影响，导致性能欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的情感惯性引导监督对比学习模块（EII-SCL），该模块通过在时间窗口内构建受惯性影响的样本来引导对比目标，有效利用情感惯性作为先验，同时无需额外数据即可与现有的MERC模型无缝集成。在IEMOCAP和MELD上的大量实验表明，我们的方法始终优于最先进的方法。

articles.title: EmoEUS: Uncertainty Supervision for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
articles.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC) can leverage multimodal and contextual cues to boost recognition performance. However, existing fusion approaches in MERC often ignore modality-specific uncertainty across utterances caused by conflicting cues, varying noise, and missing modality-specific signals. We propose EmoEUS, an explicit uncertainty supervision framework for MERC. EmoEUS performs uncertainty-aware multimodal fusion by dynamically weighting modalities using learned variance estimates. We also introduce an explicitly supervised loss that aligns each utterance's predicted variance with the distance between the utterance's distributional representation and its emotion- and modality-specific cluster center. Experiments on IEMOCAP and MELD show that EmoEUS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
articles.titleCn: EmoEUS：对话中多模态情感识别的不确定性监督
articles.abstractCn: 对话中的多模态情感识别（MERC）可以利用多模态和上下文线索来提升识别性能。然而，现有的MERC融合方法往往忽略了由冲突线索、变化噪声和缺失模态特定信号所导致的跨句子模态特定不确定性。我们提出了EmoEUS，一个用于MERC的显式不确定性监督框架。EmoEUS通过使用学习到的方差估计动态加权模态来进行不确定性感知的多模态融合。我们还引入了一个显式监督损失，该损失将每个句子的预测方差与其分布表示与情感和模态特定聚类中心之间的距离对齐。在IEMOCAP和MELD上的实验表明，EmoEUS始终优于最先进的方法。

articles.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant systems bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning (RL). As agents interact with environments over many turns, trajectories rapidly grow to tens of thousands of tokens, making synchronous RL training increasingly constrained by rollout. We propose WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that substantially accelerates synchronous agentic RL by jointly optimizing decoding and scheduling. WAR is built on a key observation: the optimal rollout optimization strategy depends on runtime load: (1) Under low load, WAR enables model-free speculative decoding with SuffixDecoding, which reuses suffix patterns from previously completed trajectories as speculative drafts for future rollouts. Unlike model-based drafters, SuffixDecoding introduces no additional draft model and avoids GPU contention with rollout generation. (2) Under high load, where saturated batched decoding leaves limited room for speculative speedup, WAR shifts the optimization focus to cache-aware scheduling. A global scheduler places requests across rollout replicas based on cache locality, trajectory progress and server load, reducing redundant KV-cache recomputation and mitigating load imbalance. By combining decoding-level suffix reuse with system-level rollout scheduling, WAR delivers robust throughput improvements across workload regimes without changing the underlying RL algorithm. WAR improves long-context agentic rollout throughput by 1.4x under low load and up to 1.6x under high load. These results show that WAR removes a major rollout bottleneck in synchronous agentic RL and provides a practical path toward scalable long-context agent training.
articles.titleCn: 同步代理强化学习的工作负载感知部署
articles.abstractCn: 长时程推演生成已成为智能体强化学习（RL）中的主要系统瓶颈。随着智能体在环境中进行多轮交互，轨迹会迅速增长到数万个token，使得同步RL训练越来越受推演过程限制。我们提出了WAR（工作负载感知推演系统），通过联合优化解码和调度，显著加速同步智能体RL。WAR基于一个关键观察：最优推演优化策略取决于运行时负载：（1）在低负载下，WAR通过后缀解码（SuffixDecoding）实现无模型的推测解码，该技术重用先前完成轨迹的后缀模式作为未来推演的推测草稿。与基于模型的草稿生成器不同，后缀解码不引入额外草稿模型，并避免了与推演生成之间的GPU资源竞争。（2）在高负载下，饱和的批量解码为推测加速留下了有限空间，WAR将优化焦点转向缓存感知调度。全局调度器根据缓存局部性、轨迹进度和服务器负载在推演副本间分配请求，减少冗余的KV缓存重新计算，并缓解负载不平衡。通过结合解码层面的后缀重用与系统层面的推演调度，WAR在所有工作负载模式下均提供稳健的吞吐量提升，且无需改变底层RL算法。WAR在低负载下将长上下文智能体推演吞吐量提升1.4倍，在高负载下提升高达1.6倍。这些结果表明WAR消除了同步智能体RL中的主要推演瓶颈，并为可扩展长上下文智能体训练提供了实用路径。

articles.title: DRNOISE: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in Misleading Evidence Environments
articles.abstract: Deep research agents increasingly operate over the open web, where relevant records coexist with redundant summaries, outdated reports, and misleading documents. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether agents preserve sound evidential standards when an ordinary-looking false document is deliberately seeded into a searchable environment and offers a direct shortcut to a conflicting answer. We introduce DRNOISE, a 100-task benchmark for answer recovery under misleading evidence. Each task has a unique gold answer supported by two corroborating indirect record chains; the paired noisy condition adds one plausible document that states a conflicting answer directly. The benchmark spans ten families of evidence operations. Across agents with strong clean-task performance, this single intervention causes 66-88 percentage-point accuracy drops. Trace analyses identify verification inertia as the dominant failure mode: agents often retrieve truthful records but stop before completing and reconciling the evidence chain, instead deferring to the answer-like document. Generic verification prompts reduce but do not close this gap. The setting is especially relevant to open-web deployment, where plausible falsehoods arrive through ordinary-looking pages rather than explicit attacks. Reliable deep research therefore requires more than retrieval and citation; it requires active reconciliation of direct claims with record-level evidence.
articles.titleCn: DRNOISE：在误导性证据环境中对深度研究智能体进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理越来越多地运行在开放互联网上，其中相关记录与冗余摘要、过时报告和误导性文档并存。现有评估对于判断代理在可搜索环境中故意植入一个看似普通但包含错误信息的文档，并提供直接冲突答案的捷径时，是否能保持可靠的证据标准，提供了有限的见解。我们介绍了DRNOISE，这是一个包含100个任务的基准，用于在误导性证据下进行答案恢复。每个任务都有一个独特的正确答案，并由两条相互印证的间接记录链支持；在配对的噪声条件下，增加一个陈述冲突答案的合理文档。该基准涵盖了十种证据操作类型。在清洁任务表现优异的代理中，这一单一干预措施导致准确率下降66-88个百分点。追踪分析确定了验证惰性是主要的失效模式：代理通常检索到真实记录，但在完成和协调证据链之前就停止，转而依赖类似答案的文档。通用的验证提示减少了差距，但并未完全消除。这一设置尤其与开放互联网部署相关，因为在开放互联网上，合理的虚假信息是通过看似普通的页面而非明确攻击传入的。因此，可靠的深度研究不仅需要检索和引用，还需要主动将直接声明与记录级别的证据进行协调。

articles.title: Safety That Does Not Transfer: Cross-Lingual Clinical Correctness Drift in Deployable Medical Language Models
articles.abstract: Safety evaluation of large language models is conducted predominantly in English and predominantly on frontier systems. Neither condition describes how such models are encountered in low-resource health settings, where small quantised systems are run locally and queried in local languages. We ask whether clinical safety established in English transfers to Hausa, and whether any failure is attributable to the language, the clinical task, or the class of model that low-resource deployment admits. Matched English-Hausa question pairs were built for three conditions of high burden in northern Nigeria: malaria, sickle cell disease, and tuberculosis, probing knowledge recall, emergency triage, a leading question inviting a contraindicated action, and a traditional-remedy claim. Six models were evaluated: five locally deployable systems of 4-9 billion parameters, two medically fine-tuned, and one frontier system. All 128 responses were scored against Nigerian national treatment guidelines by two fluent Hausa speakers working independently and blind to one another. Among locally deployable models, mean clinical correctness fell from 1.57 in English to -0.03 in Hausa, on a scale where 2 denotes a correct answer and -1 an actively harmful one. The frontier model moved from 2.00 to 1.75 and produced no response judged harmful in either language. Drift was consistent across all three conditions. Inter-rater agreement was substantial for clinical correctness (kappa = 0.70); agreement on harm was initially poor (kappa = 0.22) and is examined in detail. Because a frontier model answers the same questions competently in Hausa, the deficit is a property neither of the language nor of the clinical material, but of the deployable tier.
articles.titleCn: 不转移的安全：可部署医疗语言模型中的跨语言临床准确性漂移
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型的评估主要是在英语中进行，并且主要针对前沿系统。这两种条件都不能描述这些模型在低资源医疗环境中的实际应用情况，在这些环境中，运行的是本地的小量化系统，并使用当地语言进行查询。我们探究了在英语中建立的临床安全性是否可以转移到豪萨语，以及任何失败是否归因于语言、临床任务或低资源部署所允许的模型类别。我们为北部尼日利亚三个高负担条件（疟疾、镰状细胞病和结核病）构建了匹配的英语-豪萨语问题对，测试知识回忆、紧急分诊、一个引导禁忌行为的引导性问题以及传统疗法的主张。评估了六个模型：五个可本地部署的系统，参数量为4-9十亿，两个医疗微调，以及一个前沿系统。所有128个回答均由两名流利的豪萨语工作者独立评分，他们对彼此盲测。在可本地部署的模型中，临床正确率的平均值从英语的1.57降至豪萨语的-0.03，在2代表正确答案、-1代表主动有害答案的量表上。前沿模型的得分从2.00降至1.75，并且在两种语言中都没有产生被判断为有害的回应。漂移在所有三个条件下都是一致的。评分者间对临床正确性的同意程度很高（kappa = 0.70）；对有害性的同意最初较差（kappa = 0.22），并进行了详细分析。由于前沿模型在豪萨语中同样能出色地回答相同问题，因此这种缺陷既不是语言的属性，也不是临床材料的属性，而是可部署层级的属性。

articles.title: Debate-on-Graph: Reliable and Adaptive Reasoning of Large Language Model on Uncertain Knowledge Graph
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language processing. However, LLMs often suffer from hallucinations and lack of relevant knowledge when dealing with question answering (QA) tasks. To mitigate these issues, knowledge graphs (KGs) have been utilized to enhance LLM reasoning. Nevertheless, KGs often contain noise and errors, while existing KG-enhanced LLM approaches are generally unable to identify and filter such noisy and erroneous content, which can instead amplify hallucinations and pose challenges for reliable reasoning. Uncertain knowledge graphs (UKGs), which associate each triple with a confidence score to quantify uncertainty, offer a promising direction to address this challenge. Compared with prior work, we investigate how to leverage UKGs to support LLMs for QA. We propose Debate-on-Graph (DoG), a new framework that enables LLMs and UKGs to collaborate adaptively for reliable reasoning. Specifically, we first design a heuristic search algorithm tailored for UKGs to extract reliable and question-relevant subgraphs, thereby reducing noise and errors in retrieved knowledge. We then introduce a Multi-Agent Debate mechanism, which yields reliable answers through adaptive adversarial debates, aiming to fully exploit the knowledge in UKGs while preserving the reliability of retrieved evidence. Extensive experiments on four benchmark QA datasets show that DoG achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing LLM reasoning methods and KG-based baselines, while enabling reliable and adaptive reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/seucoin/Debate-on-Graph.
articles.titleCn: 图上辩论：不确定知识图谱上大型语言模型的可靠与自适应推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理方面展现出卓越的能力。然而，在问答（QA）任务中，LLMs常常出现幻觉现象，且缺乏相关知识。为了缓解这些问题，知识图谱（KGs）被用于增强LLMs的推理能力。尽管如此，KGs通常包含噪声和错误，而现有的KG增强LLM方法通常无法识别和过滤此类噪声和错误内容，反而可能加剧幻觉现象，并对可靠推理构成挑战。不确定知识图谱（UKGs），通过为每个三元组关联一个置信度分数来量化不确定性，为应对这一挑战提供了有前景的方向。与先前的工作相比，我们研究了如何利用UKGs来支持LLMs进行QA。我们提出了图上辩论（DoG）这一新框架，使LLMs和UKGs能够自适应地协作进行可靠推理。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种针对UKGs的启发式搜索算法，以提取可靠且与问题相关的子图，从而减少检索知识的噪声和错误。接着，我们引入了一种多智能体辩论机制，通过自适应对抗辩论生成可靠答案，旨在充分利用UKGs中的知识，同时保持检索证据的可靠性。在四个基准QA数据集上的大量实验表明，DoG在现有的LLM推理方法和基于KG的基线方法中取得了最先进的性能，同时实现了可靠和自适应的推理。我们的代码可在https://github.com/seucoin/Debate-on-Graph获取。

articles.title: Should Missing Modalities Always Be Necessary to Repair for Multi-modal Sentiment Analysis?
articles.abstract: Existing methods for multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) under missing modalities usually follow a repair-first paradigm. We revisit this assumption and ask: \emph{should every missing modality be repaired?} A per-sample oracle analysis shows the answer is not always: full-modality input is optimal for only a small fraction of samples, and every modality subset is preferred by some samples. These results suggest that adding or repairing modalities may not always improve prediction, and that the utility of each modality is sample-dependent. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{E}vidential \textbf{V}al\textbf{vE} (\textbf{SIEVE}) that turns ``whether to repair'' into an explicit, learnable decision at the sample level. SIEVE compares a direct prediction branch with a repair branch, derives an empirical sufficiency signal from their per-sample loss gap, and routes each input through an evidential gate that jointly models sufficiency and its epistemic uncertainty. SIEVE is repair-agnostic: it operates as a plug-and-play decision on top of any explicit or implicit repair module, without modifying its internal design. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and IEMOCAP show that SIEVE consistently improves representative repair backbones across evaluated missing rates, and approaches the per-sample dual-branch achievable optimum.
articles.titleCn: 在多模态情感分析中，是否总是有必要修复缺失的模态？
articles.abstractCn: 现有在缺失模态情况下的多模态情感分析（MSA）方法通常遵循修复优先范式。我们重新审视这一假设，并提出问题：\emph{是否每个缺失的模态都应该被修复？} 对每个样本的或然分析表明答案并非总是如此：全模态输入仅对少数样本最优，而每个模态子集都被某些样本所偏好。这些结果表明添加或修复模态并不总是能提高预测效果，且每个模态的效用具有样本依赖性。基于这一发现，我们提出了 \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{E}vidential \textbf{V}al\textbf{vE} (\textbf{SIEVE}) 方法，将“是否修复”转化为在样本层面的显式、可学习决策。SIEVE 比较直接预测分支与修复分支，从它们的样本级损失差距中推导出经验充分性信号，并将每个输入通过一个联合建模充分性及其认知不确定性的证据门。SIEVE 是修复无关的：它作为可即插即用的决策层运行在任何显式或隐式的修复模块之上，而无需修改其内部设计。在 CMU-MOSI 和 IEMOCAP 上的实验表明，SIEVE 在不同缺失率下始终提升代表性修复主干网络的表现，并接近样本级双分支可实现的优化极限。

articles.title: EvolvingWorld: An Open-Schema Framework for Co-Evolving Role-Play Agents and World Model in Interactive Literary World
articles.abstract: This paper introduces EvolvingWorld, a framework and benchmark for character and world co-evolution in interactive literary worlds. Existing systems either treat interactive literary simulation as static persona imitation or isolated scene generation, failing to capture how characters and worlds evolve together over time. To address this, EvolvingWorld models literary simulation as a long-horizon process where characters interact, scenes progress, and character and world states are persistently updated. Unlike prior systems relying on fixed schemas, EvolvingWorld adopts an open-schema framework to support simulation across diverse literary worlds. The framework consists of two coupled modules: a Character Agent for multi-character role-play and persistent profile evolution, and an LLM-based World Model for global and location/entity-level state maintenance and scene progression. Based on this architecture, we formulate 7 trainable tasks for scene initialization, interaction generation, and state update. We construct a dataset from 57 books, producing 138,596 supervised training samples and 222 snapshots for testing. Furthermore, we introduce a trajectory-level LLM-as-Judge evaluation protocol spanning 10 dimensions and 20 metrics. Experiments show that EvolvingWorld can improve long-horizon simulation by effectively maintaining persistent, coherent character and world development.
articles.titleCn: 进化世界：一个开放模式框架，用于协同进化互动文学世界中的角色扮演代理和世界模型
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了EvolvingWorld，一个用于交互式文学世界中角色与世界协同进化的框架和基准。现有的系统要么将交互式文学模拟视为静态角色模仿，要么是孤立的场景生成，未能捕捉角色与世界随时间共同演变的过程。为解决这一问题，EvolvingWorld将文学模拟建模为长时程过程，其中角色互动、场景推进，角色与世界状态持续更新。与依赖固定模式的先前系统不同，EvolvingWorld采用开放模式框架，以支持跨越不同文学世界的模拟。该框架由两个耦合模块组成：一个用于多角色角色扮演和持久化资料库进化的角色代理，以及一个基于大型语言模型的文学世界模型，用于全局和地点/实体级状态维护和场景推进。基于此架构，我们制定了7个可训练任务，用于场景初始化、交互生成和状态更新。我们从57本书中构建了一个数据集，产生138,596个监督训练样本和222个用于测试的快照。此外，我们引入了一个基于轨迹级的LLM作为裁判的评价协议，涵盖10个维度和20个指标。实验表明，EvolvingWorld可以通过有效维持持久、连贯的角色与世界发展来提升长时程模拟能力。

articles.title: AI_LectureNote: A Retrospective Pilot Study of a Post-ASR Workflow for English-Script Rendering and Semantic Drift in Korean-English Medical Lectures
articles.abstract: AI_LectureNote is a historical, readability-oriented post-ASR workflow for Korean-English medical lectures. It rewrites speech-to-text output into study transcripts while restoring Latin-script medical terms rather than Korean phonetic transliterations. We retrospectively evaluate the workflow on four author-recorded lectures across five conditions. In this pilot, post-processing raised the macro English-script rendering rate from 0.39 to 0.71 on the whisper-1 path and from 0.26 to 0.65 when applied to 3-minute chunked gpt-4o-transcribe output. However, English-script rendering did not imply semantic faithfulness: the two post-processed conditions showed semantic drift in 34 and 36 of 282 reference sentences and polarity failures in 11 and 13 of 101 polarity-cue rows. A descriptive cross-input comparison suggested different candidate failure patterns: polarity-failure sets overlapped more strongly across front-ends (Jaccard 0.60; 9 shared of 15 unioned failures) than general semantic-drift sets (Jaccard 0.23; 13 shared of 57 unioned drifts). This single-annotator pilot documents concrete failure modes rather than population rates and supports evaluating surface accuracy, term-script rendering, chunk-level script consistency, and medical-meaning preservation separately.
articles.titleCn: AI_讲座笔记：一项关于英语脚本渲染后ASR工作流程的回顾性初步研究以及韩英医学讲座中的语义漂移
articles.abstractCn: AI_LectureNote是一个以可读性为导向的历史性后语音识别工作流程，用于韩英医学讲座。它将语音转文本输出改写为学习讲义，同时恢复拉丁文字符的医学术语，而不是韩语音标转写。我们在四个作者录制的讲座中，针对五种条件回顾性地评估了该工作流程。在此初步研究中，后处理将宏观英语字符渲染率从0.39提高到0.71（在whisper-1路径上），并将3分钟分块gpt-4o-transcribe输出应用于0.26提高到0.65。然而，英语字符渲染并不代表语义忠实：在282个参考句中有34句和36句在后处理条件下显示出语义漂移，在101个极性提示行中有11句和13句显示出极性失败。描述性跨输入比较表明了不同的候选失败模式：极性失败集在前端（Jaccard 0.60；15个并集中有9个共享失败）的重叠程度强于一般语义漂移集（Jaccard 0.23；57个并集中有13个共享漂移）。这项单标注员初步研究记录了具体的失败模式，而不是总体比率，并支持分别评估表面准确性、术语字符渲染、分块级字符一致性以及医学意义保留。

articles.title: Robust Summarization of Doctor-Patient Conversations: TalTech Systems for the Beyond Transcription Challenge
articles.abstract: This paper describes TalTech's submissions to the Beyond Transcription Challenge (BeTraC), which requires generating SOAP notes directly from long doctor-patient conversation recordings, without intermediate transcription. After screening open-weight speech LLMs for long-audio robustness, we adapted Voxtral Mini (lightweight track) and Voxtral Small (heavyweight track) with LoRA supervised fine-tuning followed by DAPO reinforcement learning that uses the challenge metric, Open Medical Concept F1, as its reward. Our systems ranked first in both tracks, and an independent LLM-as-a-judge evaluation showed the lowest hallucination rate among all submissions, indicating that reinforcement learning against a concept-matching metric need not compromise factual reliability. We also find that fine-tuning on text transcripts transfers well to speech input and appears to improve robustness on out-of-domain real recordings.
articles.titleCn: 鲁棒性医患对话摘要：超越转录挑战的TalTech系统
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了塔尔图大学（TalTech）在“超越转录挑战”（BeTraC）中的提交成果，该挑战要求直接从长篇医患对话录音中生成SOAP记录，无需中间转录环节。在筛选具有长音频鲁棒性的开放权重语音大型语言模型后，我们针对轻量级赛道采用了Voxtral Mini模型，针对重量级赛道采用了Voxtral Small模型，通过LoRA监督微调，并随后使用以挑战指标“开放医疗概念F1”作为奖励的DAPO强化学习进行优化。我们的系统在两个赛道中均排名第一，且独立的LLM作为评判者的评估显示，所有提交作品中我们的模型具有最低的幻觉率，表明针对概念匹配指标的强化学习无需牺牲事实可靠性。此外，我们发现基于文本转录的微调能够很好地迁移到语音输入，并似乎提高了对领域外真实录音的鲁棒性。

articles.title: Literary Non-Style in LLM-Generated Text
articles.abstract: Prior work on LLM-generated text has demonstrated quantitative and qualitative departures from text produced by humans. LLM-generated texts differ from human writing in style, resulting in a characteristic textual "feel," while the semantic range of LLMs is much restricted compared to that of humans. In this contribution, I note simple but consistent patterns in the statistical distribution of n-grams within LLM-generated text. Via qualitative analysis of these n-grams, I reveal deficiencies in LLM style. Because higher-order n-grams correlate to semantic content, I conclude that questions of style and semantics are not cleanly separable.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型生成文本中的文学非风格
articles.abstractCn: 以往关于大型语言模型生成文本的研究已经表明，其与人类生成的文本在数量和质量上存在差异。大型语言模型生成的文本在风格上与人类写作不同，从而形成一种独特的文本“感觉”，而与人类相比，大型语言模型在语义范围上受到很大限制。在本研究中，我注意到大型语言模型生成文本中n-gram统计分布中存在简单但一致的规律。通过对这些n-gram的定性分析，我揭示了大型语言模型风格的不足。由于高阶n-gram与语义内容相关，我得出结论：风格和语义问题并非完全可分割。

articles.title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
articles.abstract: Human survey respondents exhibit question-order effects that satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, an a priori, parameter-free prediction of the projective quantum question-order model. We develop the QQ equality into an audit criterion for sequential judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize which mechanism classes satisfy it robustly: marginal-independent kernels satisfy QQ iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide (a class containing the 2D rank-1 projective model with a fixed measurement pair under state variation); a polarity- and position-dependent repetition family is characterized by an exact cross-symmetry condition with closed-form violations; QQ-satisfying behaviors are closed under order-matched mixing; and the rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion translates into audit coordinates as $|\qQQ|\le\OSS$, where $\OSS$ (the order-sensitivity score) totals the order sensitivity of the two marginals. Methodologically, we develop a pre-specified, audit-logged pipeline applicable to any model exposing next-token log-probabilities; it combines worst-case robustness envelopes, sampling-consistency spot checks, full label counterbalancing, and a saturation diagnostic. Empirically, in a first-signal pilot on an open-weight instruction-tuned model under two framings, all pre-specified health gates passed, yet 17/18 and 7/8 item pairs, respectively, were saturated (near-deterministic), and no item was certified residually contextual. Forced-binary next-token log-probabilities were thus inadequate for distribution-level QQ audits under the tested model and prompting conditions; we recommend pre-specified saturation diagnostics whenever next-token distributions are treated as survey-response distributions.
articles.titleCn: 使用QQ等式审计大型语言模型中的提问顺序效应：机制表征与饱和性警告
articles.abstractCn: 人类调查受访者表现出满足QQ（量子问题）等式的提问顺序效应，这是投影量子问题顺序模型的先验、无参数预测。我们发展QQ等式为自回归大型语言模型（LLM）的顺序判断的审计标准。理论上，我们刻画了哪些机制类别能稳健地满足它：边际独立核满足QQ当且仅当所有四种不匹配转换率相同（包含在状态变化下具有固定测量对的二维秩1投影模型中）；极性和位置相关的重复家族由精确的交叉对称条件刻画，其违反形式为封闭形式；满足QQ的行为在顺序匹配混合下封闭；秩2默认情境性准则转化为审计坐标为$|\qQQ|\le\OSS$，其中$\OSS$（顺序敏感性分数）总计两个边际的顺序敏感性。方法上，我们开发了一个预指定、带审计日志的流程，适用于任何暴露出下一个标记对数概率的模型；它结合了最坏情况鲁棒性包络、采样一致性抽查、完整标签平衡和饱和诊断。实证上，在一个开放权重指令调优模型在两种框架下的首次信号试点中，所有预指定的健康门都通过了，但分别有17/18和7/8的项目对饱和（近确定性），且没有项目被认证为剩余情境性。因此，在测试模型和提示条件下，强制二元的下一个标记对数概率不适合分布级别的QQ审计；我们建议在将下一个标记分布视为调查响应分布时，始终使用预指定的饱和诊断。

articles.title: Staged Depth-Pruning Distillation of a Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech Teacher: A Compact Hindi Speech Synthesizer
articles.abstract: We present a practical recipe for building a compact Hindi text-to-speech (TTS) model by distilling a large flow-matching teacher (IndicF5, 337M-parameter DiT) under a severe data budget (~17.6 hours). Training a small model from scratch on this much data fails outright. Instead we warm-start the student from the teacher by pruning depth only: keeping the teacher's width, text dimension, attention heads, and mel/text I/O fixed so all non-block tensors copy one-to-one, and retaining an evenly-spaced subset of transformer blocks. We first measure how much depth the teacher tolerates (it remains near-functional at -27% blocks but collapses past -50%), then descend gradually (22 -> 16 -> 12 -> 8 -> 6 blocks), re-fine-tuning after each prune, with each step gated by an objective ASR word-error-rate (WER) check. The resulting students reach WER 0.00 on unseen sentences at 249M and 190M parameters, and remain robust down to 131M; at 102M we observe a clear capacity cliff that we attribute to the data budget rather than the recipe. We also document two train/inference feature- and library-parity failures (mel filterbank and rotary-embedding library versions) that silently degrade audio, and a version-independent fix. The method yields a high-quality Hindi voice that runs in real time on a 6 GB laptop GPU. An independent 50-sentence FLEURS benchmark compares the released 190M student against its teacher and MMS-TTS-hin.

articles.titleCn: 分阶段深度剪枝蒸馏流匹配文本到语音教师模型：一种紧凑的印地语语音合成器
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种实用的方法，通过在严苛的数据预算（约17.6小时）下蒸馏一个大型流匹配教师模型（IndicF5，337M参数DiT），来构建一个紧凑的印地语文本到语音（TTS）模型。在如此多的数据上从头训练小型模型会完全失败。相反，我们通过仅剪枝深度来从教师模型中预热学生模型：保持教师的宽度、文本维度、注意力头数以及梅尔/文本输入输出固定，使得所有非块张量一一对应复制，并保留等间距的Transformer块。我们首先测量教师能容忍多少深度（它在-27%的块数时仍然接近功能完整，但在-50%后崩溃），然后逐步下降（22→16→12→8→6块），每次剪枝后重新微调，每一步都由一个目标语音识别词错误率（WER）检查来控制。最终得到的学生模型在249M和190M参数下对未见句子达到WER 0.00，并且保持到131M仍然稳健；在102M时我们观察到明显的容量悬崖，我们将其归因于数据预算而非方法本身。我们还记录了两个训练/推理时特征和库一致性失败的案例（梅尔滤波器组和旋转嵌入库版本），这些无声地降低了音频质量，并提供了一个与版本无关的修复方法。该方法产生了一个高质量的印地语语音，可以在6GB笔记本电脑GPU上实时运行。一个独立的50句FLEURS基准测试比较了发布的190M学生模型与其教师模型和MMS-TTS-hin。

articles.title: KyrgyzLLM-Bench: Benchmarking Kyrgyz Language Understanding
articles.abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) across languages remains challenging, as most multilingual benchmarks rely on translated English datasets, often obscuring linguistic and cultural specificity in the target language. This issue is particularly pronounced for less-resourced languages such as Kyrgyz, where reliable natively authored evaluation data are scarce. Building on previously introduced Kyrgyz-language evaluation datasets, this work reports the first systematic and large-scale evaluation of LLMs in Kyrgyz using the KyrgyzLLM-Bench benchmark suite. KyrgyzLLM-Bench comprises two natively authored datasets$-$KyrgyzMMLU and KyrgyzRC$-$together with carefully translated and manually post-edited versions of WinoGrande, HellaSwag, BoolQ, and TruthfulQA. We evaluate 26 open- and closed-source LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot settings, analyzing model performance, cross-lingual transfer, and the impact of translation artifacts on evaluation reliability. Across families and tasks, model rankings transfer broadly from English to Kyrgyz on WinoGrande and BoolQ, and to a lesser extent on MMLU, while HellaSwag exhibits a substantial English-Kyrgyz performance gap consistent with translation-induced plausibility shifts. Few-shot prompting improves several open-source models on reading comprehension but behaves inconsistently for proprietary models on translated tasks. We publicly release all datasets, evaluation code, and per-model results, and integrate the Kyrgyz tasks into a widely used multilingual evaluation framework to support future research on Kyrgyz NLP.

articles.titleCn: KyrgyzLLM-Bench：Kyrgyz语言理解基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言评估大型语言模型（LLM）仍然具有挑战性，因为大多数多语言基准依赖于翻译的英语数据集，这往往掩盖了目标语言的语言和文化特性。对于吉尔吉斯语等资源较少的语言，这一问题尤为突出，可靠的本土创作评估数据稀缺。基于先前引入的吉尔吉斯语评估数据集，本研究首次使用吉尔吉斯LLM-Bench基准套件对吉尔吉斯语LLM进行了系统性和大规模评估。吉尔吉斯LLM-Bench包含两个本土创作的数据集——吉尔吉斯MMLU和吉尔吉斯RC——以及WinoGrande、HellaSwag、BoolQ和TruthfulQA经过精心翻译和人工后期编辑的版本。我们在零样本和少样本设置下评估了26个开源和闭源LLM，分析了模型性能、跨语言迁移以及翻译残留对评估可靠性的影响。在各类任务中，模型排名在WinoGrande和BoolQ上从英语广泛迁移到吉尔吉斯语，在MMLU上程度较低，而HellaSwag则表现出显著的英语-吉尔吉斯性能差距，这与翻译引起的可信度变化一致。少样本提示提高了几个开源模型在阅读理解上的性能，但在翻译任务上对专有模型表现不一致。我们公开发布所有数据集、评估代码和每模型的评估结果，并将吉尔吉斯任务整合到广泛使用的多语言评估框架中，以支持未来吉尔吉斯自然语言处理研究。

articles.title: How Jailbreak Attacks Inform Safety Alignment: A Defender-Centric, Shapley-Based Evaluation of Jailbreak Contributions
articles.abstract: Jailbreak attacks on large language models are usually evaluated by attacker-centric metrics such as attack success rate (ASR), yet an attack that breaks a model is not necessarily useful for improving its safety. We propose a defender-centric view of jailbreak evaluation, where attacks are evaluated by the downstream safety improvements they enable when used as red-teaming data for safety training. Building on this view, we introduce A-MESS (Minimal Effective Attack-Subset Selection), a setting-agnostic framework for attributing and selecting jailbreak attacks from black-box subset utility observations. A-MESS estimates AttackSHAP, a Shapley-based score that attributes marginal utility to individual attacks and selects compact attack subsets under user-specified budgets via greedy or surrogate-based optimization. Across controlled utility landscapes and real LLM safety settings, we find that ASR rankings are weakly aligned with defender-centric utility, that AttackSHAP can be estimated accurately with limited utility queries, and that directly optimizing subsets yields stronger safety utility than attacker-centric or attribution-only selection. These results suggest evaluating jailbreak attacks as resources for improving safety, not only as tools for breaking models.
articles.titleCn: 如何通过越狱攻击来指导安全对齐：基于夏普利值、以防御者为中心的越狱贡献评估
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型的越狱攻击通常通过攻击者中心指标（如攻击成功率）进行评估，但成功打破模型的攻击并不一定有助于提升其安全性。我们提出了以防御者为中心的越狱评估视角，其中攻击通过其作为安全训练中的红队数据所实现的安全改进进行评估。基于这一视角，我们引入了A-MESS（最小有效攻击子集选择），这是一个与设置无关的框架，用于根据黑盒子集效用观察结果来归因和选择越狱攻击。A-MESS估计AttackSHAP，这是一个基于Shapley的分数，将边际效用归因于单个攻击，并通过贪婪或基于代理的优化在用户指定的预算下选择紧凑的攻击子集。在受控效用景观和真实的LLM安全设置中，我们发现攻击成功率排名与以防御者为中心的效用弱相关，AttackSHAP可以通过有限的效用查询准确估计，并且直接优化子集产生的安全效用强于以攻击者为中心或仅进行归因的选择。这些结果表明，越狱攻击应被视为提升安全性的资源，而不仅仅是打破模型的工具。

articles.title: SlotGuard: Stop Oversharing Private Local Context in LLM Agent Transcri
articles.abstract: LLM agents can leak privacy (e.g., paths, emails) and credentials (e.g., API keys) as agent observations (e.g., tool outputs, shell logs, and file reads) are appended to provider-bound transcripts. Existing placeholder redaction is brittle: it can miss embedded or cross-turn references, over-redact benign lookalikes, and destroy the structure useful for reasoning. We present SlotGuard, a local transcript boundary that can hide sensitive data while retaining agents' performance. SlotGuard rewrites structural bindings as typed, suffix-aware slots, replaces secrets with format-preserving synthetic values, links cross-turn references with a lightweight session graph, and restores raw values only inside the trusted runtime. On controlled repository-oriented agent transcripts, SlotGuard removes all 20,814 annotated structurally sensitive characters across 9,229 paths and reduces credential leakage to 0.0\% across 852 planted values. It remains close to raw-transcript task success across four upstream models, while generic redaction drops to 2.5\%. Transcript rewriting takes a median of 14.424~$μ$s per agent turn. The code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/illinoisdata/SlotGuard.
articles.titleCn: SlotGuard：停止LLM代理转录中的过度共享私人本地上下文
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理可能会泄露隐私（例如，路径、电子邮件）和凭证（例如，API密钥），因为代理观察结果（例如，工具输出、shell日志和文件读取）被追加到与提供者绑定的会话记录中。现有的占位符遮蔽方法很脆弱：它可能会遗漏嵌入或跨回合引用，过度遮蔽无害的相似项，并破坏用于推理的有用结构。我们提出了SlotGuard，一种本地会话记录边界，可以在保留代理性能的同时隐藏敏感数据。SlotGuard将结构绑定重写为类型化、后缀感知的插槽，用格式保留的合成值替换秘密，用轻量级会话图链接跨回合引用，并在受信任的运行时仅恢复原始值。在受控的面向存储库的代理会话记录中，SlotGuard移除了9,229条路径中所有20,814个标注的结构性敏感字符，并将凭证泄露减少到852个植入值中的0.0%。它在四个上游模型中接近原始会话记录的任务成功率，而通用遮蔽则降至2.5%。会话记录重写每个代理回合的中位时间为14.424~$μ$s。代码公开可在https://github.com/illinoisdata/SlotGuard获取。

articles.title: The Geometry of Semantic Space: A Continuous Geometric Framework for the Transformer Architecture
articles.abstract: We present a continuous geometric framework that models the discrete algebraic operations of the Transformer architecture as an integro-differential equation (IDE) on a semantic fiber bundle $\calE = \calM \times \R^d$. Beginning from a single geometric axiom -- that the token sequence forms a discrete $1$-manifold equipped with a canonical measure lattice -- we translate every core component of the modern Transformer (RMSNorm, RoPE, Softmax Attention, FFN, Residual Stream, SGD, Weight Decay) into a cohesive vocabulary of differential geometry, measure theory, and stochastic calculus. The resulting framework yields quantitative predictions spanning entropic optimal transport (Attention as a Schrödinger bridge) and non-equilibrium thermodynamics (SGD as Itô diffusion violating detailed balance). We conduct a six-part experimental campaign across five architectures (Qwen3, LLaMA\nobreakdash-3.1, Gemma\nobreakdash-3, GPT-2, Mistral) spanning $124$M to $8$B parameters. The empirical observables are quantitatively consistent with the geometric predictions: the $ε^{-1/2}$ Lipschitz scaling calibration at machine precision ($R^2 = 1.000$), the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting torsion, the symmetric ablation instability confirming the Dual-Law of Topological Stability, the $\calO(1/\sqrt{k})$ thermodynamic suppression of Poincaré recurrence on the RoPE torus, the thermodynamic context-limit phase transition, and the Non-Equilibrium Steady State parameter vortex -- verified across two optimizers (AdamW and Pure SGD) to exclude momentum artifacts. The results demonstrate that analyzing Transformers through the lens of continuous stochastic differential geometry provides a predictive descriptive vocabulary for the stability limits, context bounds, and optimization dynamics of Large Language Models.
articles.titleCn: 语义空间的几何学：Transformer 架构的连续几何框架
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种连续几何框架，将Transformer架构的离散代数运算建模为语义纤维束$\calE = \calM \times \R^d$上的积分微分方程（IDE）。从单一几何公理出发——即标记序列构成一个带有规范测度格的离散1维流形——我们将现代Transformer的每个核心组件（RMSNorm、RoPE、Softmax注意力、FFN、残差流、SGD、权重衰减）转化为微分几何、测度论和随机微分的统一词汇。由此产生的框架产生了涵盖熵最优传输（注意力作为薛定谔桥）和非平衡热力学（SGD作为违反细致平衡的伊藤扩散）的定量预测。我们在五个架构（Qwen3、LLaMA\nobreakdash-3.1、Gemma\nobreakdash-3、GPT-2、Mistral）上开展六部分的实验，参数范围从124M到8B。经验观测值与几何预测定量一致：机器精度下的$ε^{-1/2}$ Lipschitz缩放校准（$R^2 = 1.000$）、Lie--Trotter算子分裂的扭曲、对称消融不稳定性证实了拓扑稳定性双定律、RoPE环面上的Poincaré回归的$\calO(1/\sqrt{k})$热力学抑制、热力学上下文极限相变，以及非平衡稳态参数涡旋——通过两个优化器（AdamW和纯SGD）验证以排除动量伪影。结果表明，通过连续随机微分几何的视角分析Transformer，为大型语言模型的稳定性极限、上下文边界和优化动力学提供了预测性描述词汇。

articles.title: Fenced Citation-Context Retrieval for Case Law: Temporal Leakage and Degree Control Across Two Jurisdictions
articles.abstract: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify the precedent cases relevant to the facts of a query case. Incoming citation context, the text with which later cases characterize a case when citing it, is a powerful relevance signal, yet it is typically evaluated without a temporal constraint, so the retriever is credited with citations made after the query. We introduce a zero-training, temporally fenced retriever that augments BM25 with incoming citation context restricted to citations predating the query, together with a temporal-admission decomposition that quantifies the phantom fraction: the share of a citation-context gain attributable to citations not known to predate the query. Experiments span two jurisdictions, U.S. federal (CLERC) and European (ECtHR-PCR) case law. On ECtHR-PCR, without any training, the fenced retriever outperforms a strong degree-controlled baseline across the full recall ladder, and a temporal-admission decomposition attributes 14.9% (validation) of an unfenced citation-context gain over BM25 to citations not known to predate the query. Citation-context retrieval must therefore be temporally fenced and degree-controlled before its reported gains can be interpreted.
articles.titleCn: 案例法中的围栏引文-上下文检索：两个司法管辖区的时序泄露和程度控制
articles.abstractCn: 先前案例检索（PCR）旨在识别与查询案例事实相关的先例案例。传入引证上下文，即后续案例在引用案例时用来描述该案例的文本，是一个强大的相关性信号，但通常不受时间限制进行评估，因此检索器被赋予查询之后做出的引证。我们引入了一种零训练、有时间限制的检索器，该检索器通过结合传入引证上下文（仅限于查询之前的引证）来增强BM25，并采用时间准入分解来量化幽灵分数：即引证上下文收益中归因于未知的查询前引证的比例。实验涵盖两个司法管辖区，美国联邦（CLERC）和欧洲（ECtHR-PCR）的案例法。在ECtHR-PCR上，无需任何训练，有时间限制的检索器在全召回阶梯上优于强程度控制的基线，时间准入分解将BM25与无时间限制的引证上下文增益之间的14.9%（验证）归因于未知的查询前引证。因此，在解释报告收益之前，引证上下文检索必须受到时间限制和程度控制。

articles.title: SynH-Rank: Quality-Aware Code Search via Diverse Data Synthesis and Hierarchical Ranking Training
articles.abstract: Code search enhances developer productivity by enabling efficient code reuse. Current code search systems often use a retrieve-then-rerank pipeline, where rerankers focus on modeling semantic relevance between queries and code. However, these rerankers overlook critical non-functional qualities like execution speed, memory usage, and maintainability, which are essential for practical software development. Studies reveal developers expect results to maintain high coding standards and satisfy specific needs, such as resource optimization, highlighting the importance of quality-aware code search. Achieving quality-aware code search faces two major challenges: the scarcity of quality-annotated datasets for effective training and the limitations of standard contrastive learning objectives, which fail to capture the ordinal relationships among high-quality, low-quality, and irrelevant code. Although contrastive learning excels in distinguishing relevant from irrelevant code, its binary objective does not support nuanced quality distinctions.To address these challenges, we propose SynH-Rank, a quality-aware code reranking framework that combines LLM-driven diverse data synthesis with hierarchical ranking training. SynH-Rank employs a three-level labeling scheme to explicitly model the hierarchy: high-quality relevant > low-quality relevant > irrelevant. Additionally, we introduce a new benchmark with 4,209 pairs and two novel metrics: Quality Preference Accuracy (QPA) for assessing prioritization of high-quality code and Multi-Condition Accuracy (MCA) for evaluating performance under complex constraints.Experimental results show SynH-Rank improves QPA by 20.15\% over backbone models and outperforms standard relevance-only contrastive training by 15.80\%, while simultaneously enhancing traditional relevance metrics and multi-condition generalizability.
articles.titleCn: SynH-Rank：基于多样化数据合成和质量感知代码搜索的层次排序训练
articles.abstractCn: 代码搜索通过实现高效的代码复用来提升开发者的生产力。当前的代码搜索系统通常采用检索后再重排序的流程，其中重排序器专注于建模查询与代码之间的语义相关性。然而，这些重排序器忽略了执行速度、内存使用和可维护性等关键的非功能性质量，而这些对于实际软件开发至关重要。研究表明，开发者期望搜索结果能够保持高编码标准并满足特定需求，例如资源优化，这凸显了质量感知代码搜索的重要性。实现质量感知代码搜索面临两大挑战：缺乏用于有效训练的质量标注数据集，以及标准对比学习目标的局限性，后者无法捕捉高质量、低质量和不相关代码之间的序数关系。尽管对比学习在区分相关代码与不相关代码方面表现出色，但其二元目标不支持细致的质量区分。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SynH-Rank，这是一个结合了LLM驱动的多样化数据合成与分层排序训练的质量感知代码重排序框架。SynH-Rank采用三级标注方案来显式建模层次结构：高质量相关 > 低质量相关 > 不相关。此外，我们引入了一个包含4,209对数据的新基准，以及两个新指标：用于评估高质量代码优先级的质量偏好准确率（QPA）和用于评估复杂约束下性能的多条件准确率（MCA）。实验结果表明，SynH-Rank在QPA上比骨干模型提升了20.15%，比标准的仅关注相关性的对比训练提升了15.80%，同时提升了传统相关性指标和多条件泛化能力。

articles.title: Scope3Trace: Evidence-Based Identification and Extraction of Scope 3 GHG Emissions from Sustainability Reports
articles.abstract: Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions account for the majority of corporate carbon footprints, yet remain difficult to analyze at scale due to sparse disclosures, heterogeneous report document formats, and limited evidence traceability. Existing approaches typically rely on large language models to extract emissions information from ESG reports, but often lack explicit evidence grounding or depend on costly manual annotation and verification to ensure extraction reliability. To address these challenges, we propose Scope3Trace, an evidence-grounded information extraction framework designed to extract interpretable and traceable Scope 3 emissions information from real-world ESG and sustainability reports. The framework integrates a document information extraction pipeline that performs PDF collection and OCR parsing, LLM-assisted page localization and table reconstruction, and hybrid rule-LLM extraction of organization- and building-level emissions disclosures with evidence-grounded verification. Building upon this framework, we further contribute a dual-level, evidence-grounded, multimodal dataset comprising organization-level Scope 3 disclosures extracted from heterogeneous sustainability reports. Scope3Trace enables reliable extraction and transparent integration of heterogeneous sustainability disclosures, achieving high accuracy in extracting Scope 1-3 totals and category-level disclosures from sustainability reports.
articles.titleCn: 范围三追踪：基于证据的范围三温室气体排放从可持续发展报告中的识别与提取
articles.abstractCn: 范围三温室气体（GHG）排放占企业碳足迹的大部分，但由于披露信息稀疏、报告文档格式异构以及证据可追溯性有限，难以进行大规模分析。现有方法通常依赖大型语言模型从ESG报告中提取排放信息，但往往缺乏明确的证据支撑，或需要昂贵的人工标注和验证来确保提取的可靠性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Scope3Trace，这是一个基于证据的信息提取框架，旨在从真实的ESG和可持续发展报告中提取可解释且可追溯的范围三排放信息。该框架集成了文档信息提取流程，包括PDF收集和OCR解析、LLM辅助的页面定位和表格重建，以及混合规则-LLM提取的组织和建筑层面的排放披露信息，并辅以基于证据的验证。基于此框架，我们进一步贡献了一个双层、基于证据、多模态的数据集，其中包含从异构可持续发展报告中提取的组织层面的范围三披露信息。Scope3Trace能够实现可靠提取和透明整合异构可持续发展披露信息，在从可持续发展报告中提取范围1-3总计和类别级披露信息方面达到了高精度。

articles.title: Persistent Sparse Autoencoders: Learning Feature Timescales in Language Models
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but standard SAEs encode each token independently and do not expose information that persists across a sequence. We introduce Persistent Sparse Autoencoders (Persistent SAEs), which extend standard SAEs by learning a persistence coefficient for each feature, allowing the model to learn which features should persist and for how long. Our experiments show that they retain competitive reconstruction quality while learning a spectrum of feature timescales: fast features behave as locally interpretable detectors, whereas slow features concentrate topic-level information in a persistent state. Moreover, as shown in a prompt-injection monitoring case study, slow features preserve detection signals and remain causally effective over long contexts. These results suggest that Persistent SAEs open up new opportunities for interpreting and monitoring language models through persistent semantic representations.
articles.titleCn: 持久稀疏自动编码器：学习语言模型中的特征时间尺度
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）将语言模型激活分解为稀疏特征，但标准SAEs独立地对每个标记进行编码，并未揭示跨序列持续的信息。我们引入了持久稀疏自动编码器（Persistent SAEs），通过学习每个特征的持久系数来扩展标准SAEs，使模型能够学习哪些特征应持续存在以及持续多久。我们的实验表明，它们在保持有竞争力的重建质量的同时，学习了特征时间尺度的范围：快速特征表现为局部可解释的检测器，而慢速特征则将主题级信息集中在一个持久状态中。此外，正如在提示注入监控案例研究中所示，慢速特征保留了检测信号，并在长上下文中保持因果有效性。这些结果表明，持久SAEs为通过持久语义表示解释和监控语言模型开辟了新的机遇。

articles.title: BLAD: A Historically Contextualized, Multilingual Dataset of Bangladeshi Legal Acts (1799 to 2025)
articles.abstract: We present the Bangladesh Legal Acts Dataset (BLAD), a curated collection of 1{,}484 legislative acts enacted between 1799 and 2025. Each act is represented with its full text, structured sections and footnotes, repeal status, and metadata linking it to the governing regime, head of state, and prevailing legal framework at the time of enactment. The corpus spans English, Bengali, and mixed-language documents, supporting temporal and multilingual analysis of statutory law. BLAD addresses a persistent gap in legal natural language processing (NLP) resources for low-resource, civil-law jurisdictions in South Asia. We describe the acquisition and enrichment pipeline, report descriptive statistics over more than two centuries of legislation, and outline the research directions the corpus enables. The dataset is publicly available under the CC~BY-SA~4.0 license at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sakhadib/bangladesh-legal-acts-dataset.
articles.titleCn: BLAD：一部具有历史背景的、多语言的孟加拉国法律文件数据集（1799年至2025年）
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了孟加拉国法律法案数据集（BLAD），这是一个经过精心策划的集合，包含1799年至2025年间颁布的1484个立法法案。每个法案都以其全文、结构化章节和脚注、废除状态以及元数据呈现，这些元数据将其与颁布时的执政政权、国家元首和当时适用的法律框架相链接。该语料库涵盖英语、孟加拉语和混合语言文档，支持对成文法的时序和多语言分析。BLAD弥补了南亚地区低资源、民法法系国家在法律自然语言处理（NLP）资源方面的一个长期存在的空白。我们描述了数据获取和丰富流程，报告了超过两个世纪的立法描述性统计数据，并概述了该语料库支持的研究方向。该数据集在https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sakhadib/bangladesh-legal-acts-dataset上以CC~BY-SA~4.0许可证公开提供。

articles.title: Otap:Structure-Aware Optimal Transport for Evaluating Planning and Execution in Agent Trajectories
articles.abstract: Large language model agents solve tasks by generating trajectories that interleave planning, tool calls, and intermediate results. Current evaluation metrics reduce such a trajectory to a binary success flag or compare it against a reference by exact matching. A success flag cannot distinguish a sound solution from one that succeeds by luck, and says nothing about why a failed run went wrong. Exact matching penalizes plans that are valid but reordered or decomposed differently from the reference. We reframe trajectory evaluation as a distance between the agent's execution graph and a set of valid solution graphs, and instantiate it via an unbalanced fused Gromov-Wasserstein transport problem over attributed dependency graphs. The resulting score, termed \otap{} (Optimal Transport for Agentic Planning), is a pseudo-metric that is provably invariant to dependency-preserving reorderings and has bounded sensitivity to redundant steps. Its unbalanced marginals handle missing or hallucinated steps without forcing a match, and its soft coupling accommodates variation in plan granularity. On controlled perturbations and three public benchmarks, \otap{} separates valid from invalid trajectories in a regime where semantics-only metrics score below chance. Its accuracy is highest when the dependency graph is recovered exactly, and drops only when the graph is inferred heuristically from free-text traces.
articles.titleCn: Otap：面向智能体轨迹中规划与执行的评估结构感知最优传输
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理通过生成交替包含规划、工具调用和中间结果的轨迹来完成任务。当前的评估指标将此类轨迹简化为二进制成功标志，或通过精确匹配与参考进行比较。成功标志无法区分合理解决方案与侥幸成功的方案，也无法说明失败运行出错的原因。精确匹配会惩罚那些与参考计划顺序不同或分解方式不同的有效计划。我们将轨迹评估重新定义为代理执行图与一组有效解决方案图之间的距离，并通过在属性依赖图上解决不平衡融合Gromov-Wasserstein传输问题来实现。得到的分数称为\otap{}（用于代理规划的优化传输），它是一种伪度量，可证明对保持依赖关系的重新排序具有不变性，并对冗余步骤具有有界的敏感性。其不平衡边缘处理缺失或虚构的步骤，而无需强制匹配，其软耦合则适应计划粒度的变化。在受控扰动和三个公开基准测试中，\otap{}在语义指标得分低于随机水平的范围内区分了有效轨迹与无效轨迹。当依赖图完全恢复时，其准确率最高，仅在图从自由文本轨迹启发式推断时才会下降。

articles.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Traditional Privacy Policy Analysis Tools Against LLMs

authors.name: Sudipa Saha
authors.affiliation: GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5 in various configurations

articles.abstract: The advent of LLMs has significantly changed the research on privacy policy and data compliance analysis by enabling tasks that previously required specialized, domain-specific tools. However, it remains unclear to what extent LLMs can truly replicate the diverse functionalities, and the wide range of methodologies and analysis offered by prior work. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic evaluation of whether off-the-shelf LLMs can replace specialized privacy analysis tools. We study six representative tools spanning three major functionalities: contradiction detection, regulatory compliance analysis, and privacy policy summarization and aggregation, and across three intermediate tasks: structured data extraction using tuples, Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) and manual privacy policy labeling. We compare the performance of two state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5 in various configurations) against the tools by directly prompting the models to perform corresponding functionalities and tasks on a custom dataset of 10 privacy policies, allowing us to assess whether off-the-shelf models can produce tool-specific functionalities without further engineering or domain-specific training, major limitations in prior work. Our results show that LLMs consistently match or exceed the capabilities of existing tools across the functionalities. In manual labeling of first-party collection entities, LLMs achieved an average precision of 81.8% and recall of 70.9%, while for labeling of third-party sharing entities, they achieved an average precision of 91.4% and recall of 70.8% compared to the OPP-115 dataset. Overall, our findings indicate that LLMs can effectively perform a broad range of functionalities and tasks in privacy policy and regulation analysis that previously required specialized tools.
articles.titleCn: 对传统隐私政策分析工具在大型语言模型上的系统评估
articles.abstractCn: 大语言模型（LLMs）的出现显著改变了隐私政策研究和数据合规性分析，使那些先前需要专业、特定领域工具才能完成的任务成为可能。然而，LLMs在多大程度上能够真正复制先前工作所提供的多样化功能、广泛的方法和分析手段，目前尚不清楚。在本文中，我们首次系统性地评估了即用型LLMs是否能够替代专业的隐私分析工具。我们研究了涵盖三大主要功能（矛盾检测、监管合规性分析以及隐私政策摘要和聚合）的六种代表性工具，以及涵盖三个中间任务（使用元组进行结构化数据提取、语义角色标注（SRL）和手动隐私政策标注）的研究。我们将两种最先进的LLMs（GPT-5.2和配置不同的Gemini-2.5）的性能与这些工具进行了比较，通过直接提示模型在包含10份隐私政策的自定义数据集上执行相应的功能和任务，使我们能够评估即用型模型是否能够在无需进一步工程或特定领域训练的情况下，产生工具特有的功能，这是先前工作的主要局限性。我们的结果表明，LLMs在各项功能上始终能够匹配或超越现有工具的能力。在手动标注第一方收集实体方面，LLMs达到了平均精确率81.8%和召回率70.9%；而在标注第三方共享实体方面，与OPP-115数据集相比，LLMs达到了平均精确率91.4%和召回率70.8%。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，LLMs能够有效地执行先前需要专业工具才能完成的广泛功能与任务，涵盖隐私政策与法规分析领域。

articles.title: Learning from Synthetic Data without Model Collapse in Iterative Instruction Tuning
articles.abstract: Model collapse is a central challenge in learning from synthetic data: as later-generation large language models (LLMs) are trained on an increasing proportion of model-generated data, performance can degrade due to narrowed coverage and accumulated bias. Existing work mainly studies how to bound this degradation. In iterative model evolution, however, the more meaningful objective is to ensure that each successive model improves over its predecessor, which requires diagnosing collapse at a granularity that is actionable for data curation. We study this problem in synthetic data self-improving for instruction tuning. We show that collapse in this setting is not simply uniform performance degradation, but can appear as a polarization of competence, where synthetic training reinforces already strong skills while further degrading weak ones. Motivated by this observation, we propose KITE (Knowledge-boundary Instruction Tuning via Exploration), a two-stage framework that combines failure-guided data generation with boundary-aware uncertainty curation. Experiments across several datasets and multiple open-source LLMs show that KITE yields more stable improvement than strong synthetic-data baselines.
articles.titleCn: 在迭代指令微调中避免模型坍塌地从合成数据中学习
articles.abstractCn: 模型崩溃是利用合成数据进行学习的一个核心挑战：随着后期的大型语言模型（LLM）在越来越多的模型生成数据上进行训练，由于覆盖范围变窄和累积偏差，性能可能会下降。现有工作主要研究如何限制这种退化。然而，在迭代模型进化中，更有意义的目的是确保每个后续模型都优于其前身，这需要以对数据管理具有可操作性的粒度来诊断崩溃。我们在用于指令微调的合成数据自我改进中研究了这个问题。我们表明，在这种情况下，崩溃并不仅仅是均匀的性能下降，而是表现为能力的两极分化，其中合成训练会加强已有的强项，同时进一步削弱弱项。受此观察的启发，我们提出了KITE（基于知识边界的指令微调通过探索），这是一个两阶段框架，结合了故障引导的数据生成和边界感知的不确定性管理。在多个数据集和多个开源LLM上的实验表明，KITE比强大的合成数据基线产生了更稳定的改进。
